title: Lester's speech, "Lady" and Pee Wee Marquette
summary: Jones recalls Lester calling everyone Lady, his lucky 13, and his running joke tipping Pee Wee Marquette.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Can you give me any reasons, knowing him as well you did, he called everybody Miss So-and-So or Mr. So-and-So. He called me Miss Hinton.
Now you know what he did - no, he didn't call that. He called everybody Lady. Lady Jacquet. Lady Hinton.

He always says, "How's your feelings?" When he said how are your feelings he meant, "how was your family?" "How's your feelings today," you see. His lucky number was 13. He never bet nothing but 13, 13. Pee Wee Marquette used to come down here and he'd tip Pee Wee Marquette and he said, "I gave you $13 and I'll hit you and I'll make you tall as Will the Stilt. You little midget."
He had a name he called him. He called Pee Wee Marquette something, because Pee Wee Marquette for the record's sake is like - what would you call that? Is he a midget or would you call that a dwarf?
He's a cross between a dwarf and a midget. I've only known Pee Wee since 1926.
He's really not a midget but in my sight, he's black.
But he is a midget, he is definitely a midget. He's of the midget family.
I remember one fantastic expression when Pee Wee made Pres mad one night and Pres called him little half-a-motherfucker.
But he still gave him thirteen dollars. He'd say, "Aw, Come on, Pres." "Where do you get that, Pres, you little half-a-point."
He'd call him a motherfucker, which is an appreciative word.
.....But it was all love. The man lived that.
